# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel Colby is a dark-eyed girl with rose-red cheeks. At Regent's Academy, she was voted the beauty among the Second Year classes.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses a warm, dark-eyed beauty paired with a heart brimming with yearning dreams and imaginations. While she can experience bouts of gloom and discontent, she is a loyal, supportive friend who appreciates humor and the company of kindred spirits.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v3 c9 P0](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0000), [v3 c9 P15](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0015), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)_

## Traits

- Imaginative and dream-filled  <sub>[v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000)</sub>
- Loyal and supportive friend  <sub>[v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>
- Dislikes boarding and domestic drudgery  <sub>[v1 c26 P12](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0012), [v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013)</sub>

## Abilities

- Knitting lace  <sub>[v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020)</sub>
- Essay writing  <sub>[v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- Attending college at Wexcombe to earn a degree  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 c26 P11](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0011)</sub>

## History

Mabel Colby attended Regent's Academy with Nell Harcourt and her circle of friends, where she was recognized for her dark-eyed beauty. After completing her third year, she worked as a rural schoolteacher for two years, experiencing the comedy and hardship of managing pupils and demanding parents. Eager to escape rural teaching and boarding, she proposed renting a house in Portmaris named Tabby's Place with Nell, Honora Hollis, and Cressida Lindsay, arranged under the care of her Aunt Euphemia. Mabel entered the Sophomore class at Wexcombe College, where she took an active part in student life, writing for the Philomathic Society and participating in the Brierley Village Improvement Society. After completing her studies at Wexcombe, she relocated to Vancouver to work as a teacher.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 c26 P11](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0011), [v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v3 c9 P0](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0000), [v3 c36 P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_
